STUDENT ARTICLE TITLE: 2
STUDENT ARTICLE:
"Academic Excellence" Waking up at early hours in the morning can be classified as a daunting task, more so if we must go to class. Falling back to sleep whilst watching your online classes can cost you time and your academic success. Having this in mind, in this article I’ll be going over the main reasons as to why university students should physically attend to their classes. Have you ever felt lost during a class? Because I have, a ton of times. Thankfully, due to my physical attendance in class, I am able to inquire the teacher regarding any possible questions that may arise during the class, and teacher will swiftly veer me on to the correct path, and I am eternally grateful for this. since it is not as easy, fast, and comprehensible, when you are learning from a distance - watching classes online Another upside to attending classes in-person is your immediate access to resources (eg teachers books) and facilities (e.g. labs, libraries…) , I definitely do not have this at home! In conclusion, the decision to attend classes in-person is ultimately left to the student, but I firmly believe that teachers can entourage their fellow students to physically attend their classes, a way to encourage such behaviour could be by implementing. "extra-points" reward system to those attending closes in-person, helping the early birds achieve higher grades!

For this reason, universities have decided to continue the lessons in online-hybrid. format, wich avoids students to commute to the university and makes things eaiser for them. Despite this, online classes have demonstrated not to be as effective as presential ones. Many students can’t keep their focus on studies being all day at their homes without interaction with other students and proffessors. Moreover, some students directly don't attend to classs due to their lack of motivation, Another problem related with this format is that laboratory sessions can't be realised or not in the proper way. For this reason, profpessors shoud encourage students to retake physicall classes. Also, they should convince them. that going physically to class has more benefits than being at home, since when they are at the campus they have all the facilities and resources that they need as a sports area or libraries, where they are more productive. Finally, online-hybrid format has shown to be an alternative to traditional teaching system, but not an alternative to repace it because of its problems. As I said before, teachers should encourage students to attend to the lessons physically and to retake the normal leaming pace that they had before, since, as demonstrated previously, is higher than the current pace.

STUDENT ARTICLE TITLE: 11
STUDENT ARTICLE:
Do you think attending classes in-person have an added value? Nowadays, online learning is becoming increasingly popular these days at universities, but it should not underestimate the importance of attending classes in-person. Not only participating face-to-face learning enrichs academic experience at but it also provides students with essential resources. Besides, it promotes a sense of community that can not be acquired online. Additionally, the main benefit of attending classes-in-person is direct interaction between teachers and students. This allows. then to share spontaneous discussions and real time to clarify doubts. In addition, students can concentrate better as classrooms provide a good environment. Furthermore, another important point is students improve softs skills such as: time management, teamwork, leadership, conflict resolution and assertive communication which are vital for personal and professional growth. On the other hand, it is important to suggest different ways to encourage students and to do so, teachers should promote interactive teaching methods by sharing group activities or practical lessons. Probably, they could motivate students if they make enjoyable and participatory classes. To sum up, attending classes in-person will transform education into an immersive multi- dimensional experience. This also prepares students to learn how to cope and face challenges in their lives..

STUDENT ARTICLE TITLE: 12
STUDENT ARTICLE:
Are online classes as bright as they should? Nowadays it is shared the believe that every schedule will improve if work it becomes online. Thousands of experts are arguing about the way students are evolving during this technological change. To begin with, it is known that online classes became real in 2020, with the CoviD-19 crisis. Nobody could go out of their houses, so the colleges and universities started to show their employees how to teach with their laptops and gadgets. Nevertheless, four years laters students still don't have a clear idea about which is the best way to learn. Many students think that staying at home is more comfortable and cheaper, as they don't have to take any transport to go to the college or university. But the truth is that physically attending classes gives students much more resources than they think. For example, attending classes are a way to help shy people with their relationships. Also, there is not the same fluency in be an online class where students tend to be more "disconnected", than in a physical class where they see the teachers face to face. Moreover, is easier to pay attention to the class if the student has done the effort of coming to it. And teachers also tend to be more interactive with the students during physically attending classes. In conclusion, teachers should encourage students to go to class by sending them team works organising "dialogue events" at the class, to make them feel the need of going to college. If teachers acted actively by this way, students would prefer physically attending classes instead of staying at home with boring online classes.

STUDENT ARTICLE TITLE: 13
STUDENT ARTICLE:
THE BEST WAY TO LEARN Nowadays, online classes are getting more and more common between universities. But are they the best way to learn? Firstly, physically attending classes are funnier. It is easier for students to keep their focus when they are listening to a person, in this case the teacher, and not a computer. The communication is more fluent as you get to see gestures and expressions. Another advantage of physically attending classes is that students can use other resources, such as sport facilities. Sports like football or tennis can be played at university after classes if you go physically. Moreover, going everyday to university allows you to see your friends for several hours a day. Have you ever thought about how lovely it would be for us, as students, to complete a degree taking online classes only? We are social animals by nature and going outside everyday helps our mental health, avoiding illnesses like depression or anxiety. Some Suggestions in which teachers can encourage students to go to class could be taking in consideration attendance. A small part of the final mark could be gained through observation and interest showed. Another way could be to reserve some class dates for doubts answering. To sum up, physically attending classes have more advantages than disadvantages, and if those suggestions were implemented, the number of students that go to class would increased and they would also feel more motivated to attend to university everyday.
